title: The First Crossing | ECHO//100 Episode 76
description:
Kavi traverses a surreal glass dimension to confront the architect of his own unending temporal trap. He discovers that his journey is a self-sustaining cycle fueled by his own past actions. Episode 76 of ECHO//100: ARC. This is an original work of fiction generated with the assistance of AI.

This is original AI-assisted animated fiction.

scenes.text: The red door shatters, depositing Kavi into a chamber forged from fragile, transparent glass.
scenes.caption: The Glass Bedroom
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi in his red hoodie and glasses standing in a bedroom where walls and furniture are made of clear glass, cinematic vertical perspective.

scenes.text: Kavi stares at a reflection, but the room remains empty save for static electricity.
scenes.caption: Echoes of the past
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi looking at his own distorted reflection in a glass dresser, glowing blue energy lines tracing the walls.

scenes.text: A young boy sits in the corner clutching a phone, awaiting a silent signal.
scenes.caption: The First Kavi
scenes.image_prompt: A young boy version of Kavi sitting on a glass bed holding an old vintage phone, glowing red light behind him.

scenes.text: Byte hovers behind Kavi, his cyan face flickering with Mira’s urgent, digitized loop warning.
scenes.caption: Byte’s fractured warning
scenes.image_prompt: Byte the floating white robot with a glowing cyan face and orange antenna pointing toward the young boy.

scenes.text: Kavi reaches for the boy, but hands dissolve into blue holographic light like Mira.
scenes.caption: Identity dissolving
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi’s hands turning into translucent blue pixels while he reaches toward the young boy in the glass room.

scenes.text: The realization strikes; Kavi exists not to save the child, but to transmit signals.
scenes.caption: The loop revealed
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi staring in horror as he realizes his backpack is emitting the same signal the boy is waiting for.

scenes.text: Reality fractures as a dark, glitchy hand emerges from the red door, hunting him.
scenes.caption: Null arrives
scenes.image_prompt: A massive, black-purple glitch-filled hand with red eyes emerging from a swirling red portal in the glass wall.

scenes.text: The boy screams while dragged into the void, resetting the timeline for Kavi's arrival.
scenes.caption: Cycle restarts
scenes.image_prompt: The young boy being pulled into the red portal while Kavi watches, helpless, as the room begins to shatter.
